name: arcana-tarot
description: Arcana — App de lecturas de Tarot y Oráculo (frontend + API + base de datos)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @arcana/tarot-core && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @arcana/tarot-core && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm run test:watch -w backend" "npm run test:watch -w frontend"
